## Fellowships & Awards

::: news-card
### ICO Award for Excellence in Coffee-Related Research

**International Coffee Organization (ICO)** · June 2019

This award promotes high-quality research on emerging issues in the global coffee sector.

**Related paper:** *Access to High Quality Coffee Markets: Possible for All?*

[Award call](http://www.ico.org/documents/cy2018-19/ed-2295e-call-for-award-competition.pdf){target="_blank"}

![](/files/images/ICO.png){width="35%"}
:::

**COLCIENCIAS (now Minciencias)** · 2017–2020

National doctoral scholarship awarded to support PhD studies in Colombia.
